keyDates.text: TODAY: EA/ED application season in full swing. Brown, Cornell, Dartmouth, Penn, Yale ED1 deadlines November 1-2.
Most Ivy ED1 and EA deadlines for Class of 2031. Brown ED1 deadline November 1.
Public comment period closes on DHS proposed $70,000 OPT fee rule. Higher ed associations mobilizing responses.
Harvard expected to release Class of 2030 admissions data via mandatory IPEDS/Common Data Set filing - second consecutive year of delayed disclosure.
Regular Decision deadlines for most selective universities in the 2026-27 application cycle (Class of 2031).
ED2 deadlines for Ivy and peer institutions. Strong option for students deferred from ED1 rounds.
ED Department publishes first Earnings Premium test results under OBBBA STATS framework. Programs failing twice in three years risk losing Direct Loan eligibility by July 2028.
National Decision Day 2027 - Class of 2031 deposit deadline. Yield season begins.

charts.title: DHS Proposed OPT Fee Structure Per Student
charts.footnote: Fees would be paid by SEVP-certified institutions per student OPT recommendation. Open for public comment through November 9, 2026.
